v21-6.candidate: David answered the priest and said to him, “But we have abstained from a woman yesterday and the third day. When I went out on the road, all the young men had been purified. The road itself is common, for it will be sanctified today because of my equipment.”

v22-23.candidate: Stay with me; do not fear. For wherever I seek a place for my soul, I will seek one for your soul too, for you are protected with me.”

v21-12.display:
Achish’s servants said to him, “Is this not David, the king of the land? Is this not the one for whom the dancing women led the song, saying,
‘Saul has struck his thousands,
and David his tens of thousands’?”
